title: Provide new client and server websocket handshake exceptions

timeline.body:
Motivation:

At the moment we have only one base `WebSocketHandshakeException` for handling WebSocket upgrade issues.
Unfortunately, this message contains only a string message about the cause of the failure, which is inconvenient in handling.

Modification:

Provide new `WebSocketClientHandshakeException` with `HttpResponse` field  and `WebSocketServerHandshakeException` with `HttpRequest` field both of them without content for avoid reference counting 
problems. 

Result:

More information for more flexible handling.

Fixes #10277 #4528 #10639.
Can one of the admins verify this patch?
@normanmaurer, @slandelle PTAL when you have a time

IMHO, I don't think the extra `allow*HandshakeException` flags are necessary, since both `WebSocketClientHandshakeException` and `WebSocketServerHandshakeException` extend `WebSocketHandshakeException`. I mean, `catch (WebSocketHandshakeException e)` and `e instanceof WebSocketHandshakeException` will still work. I hope no one is using `e.getClass() == WebSocketHandshakeException.class`. I think the extra flags just complicate the code without much benefit.

timeline.body: @philsttr, @chrisvest PTAL again

I wonder if it would be better to expose the protocol, status and headers directly here. This would make it clear that this `HttpResponse` is never a `FullHttpResponse` and so not needs to be released. WDYT ?

reply.body: I thought about this, but we have situations when an exception occurs before receiving a response and we do not have this data and all fields will be null, which is inconvenient (need to check before use) or we can throw the different type of exceptions with response data and  without it.
got it... maybe we should just add to the java docs that this will never be `ReferenceCounted` and so no special treatment is needed.
Make sense, even that WebSocket Handshake request/response in theory should not contain payload, but this is not explicitly prohibited by the RFC 😲
